method.viewport: 390x844 logical CSS pixels; desktop Chrome, not physical phone
method.latency: 200ms response delay on static and API requests; local proxy, no bandwidth/CPU throttle, not actual Tailnet RTT replay
method.cache: Independent cold origins, no-store static responses; same live Core with empty Channels/active Roles and 50 retained deleted Roles
method.click: Captured real click to page container visible plus two animation frames; no fixed Suspense timer
method.usable: Separate DOM-ready checks. Published only for Tasks, Agent, Settings shell and Memory empty state; not a global all-data-ready metric
method.sampling: Three cold-source pairs from final build, alternating before/after against PID41326 and identical live data; all seven destinations completed. Each Home waited for the same visible-shell plus400ms ready marker.
method.moreWarmup: One speculative module at a time while More is open; closing cancels remaining queue, target intent may start its own module without waiting.
method.network: Synthetic 200ms delay per static/API response. Shared HTTP live Core; mobile browser viewport on local Chrome, not remote phone or full mobile CPU/network emulation.

measurementLimits: Activity readiness probe did not reliably detect its header; Computer readiness probe incorrectly matched workspace chooser before the page. Both usable fields excluded from conclusions in both arms; raw records retained.
Settings usable is the mobile settings list shell, not every settings panel data. Memory has no Channel data in this deployment and includes existing 200ms empty-query debounce.
Some page-body data reads still require network round trips. Module warming cannot repair actual Tailnet stalls or physical mobile CPU/rendering.
A first load may not leave enough idle time to finish warming; constrained connections skip speculation.
The fixed 400ms dwell after the visible Home shell is identical in complete before/after journeys. More menu uses actual automation action pacing, not a prescribed human dwell.
Firefox fresh-page recheck after deployment was blocked by native cgWindowNotFound; certificate-verified Node HTTPS checks and fresh real Chrome HTTP pages are separate evidence.

cacheMismatchRetained.reason: Before used the pilot warm-cache origin: script transferSize=0 and duration~1ms. Kept separately as mixed-cache observation, not combined with cold-source pairs. Added independent localhost origin pair for the third cold-source cell.

priorIterations.pilot: before-1 incomplete journey; before-2 load probe matched hidden desktop navigation and never completed
priorIterations.v1: after-1/2/3 parallel More warmup caused resource contention; replaced by serial cancellable queue
priorIterations.final: All three final journeys retained, no replacement based on their measured time
